modules.name: Official School Calendar (Côte d'Ivoire)
modules.description: Official Ivorian primary-school calendar (3 trimestres, 5 school breaks, 9 evaluations incl. CEPE, 14 fériés). **Bridge mode**: one-click import into the existing AcademicCalendarTab UI via POST /api/v1/calendar/import-official. Self-contained: owns its own tables (mod_calendar_*), mounts as a Hono sub-app or deploys as a standalone Worker.
modules.author: perissosdigitalsolution-oss
